I'm an economist with the Government of Saskatchewan's Ministry of Finance, where I build models that show how the economy is doing and what a shock to it would cost.

I grew up in Ghana and studied economics at the University of Ghana and the University of Saskatchewan.

Here I play with data that catches my eye, and share the notebooks so you can too.

Rebuilt one of my notebooks, or got a different number? I'd love to hear from you: **agyeponglawrence101@gmail.com**
